# Bundled fonts

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl

- montserrat.ttf: montserrat/Montserrat[wght].ttf
- barlow.ttf: barlow/Barlow-ExtraBold.ttf (weight 800)
- comfortaa.ttf: comfortaa/Comfortaa[wght].ttf
- manrope.ttf: manrope/Manrope[wght].ttf

Original font files, downloaded 2026-09-15. Each family's OFL license is included alongside its font.
Bahnschrift and Consolas are resolved from the Windows installation and are not redistributed.
